change: One host-wide free-RAM floor (1 GiB, resource_policy.RAM_RESERVE_BYTES) replaces every per-model available-RAM figure at load admission.
request: one short chat request per model through the hub, 64-token limit, temperature 0
scope: Loads started with 15-58 GiB available, so they exercise the changed admission code, not the 1 GiB boundary; the boundary is covered by unit tests only.
refused_switch: Flash-Next to Maya DeepSeek was refused twice by the unchanged VRAM check (16 GiB free per card), which Maya reads once right after the previous backend stops. Not a RAM refusal; the older, stricter RAM check ran at the same point. No hold, no kernel fault. Fixed later the same day with a bounded wait; see vram_release_wait.

vram_release_wait.change: The 16 GiB-per-card check of Maya, qualified native and Strata DeepSeek polls for up to 15 s after a switch instead of reading once.
vram_release_wait.retest: Flash-Next loaded, then a request for DeepSeek Q1 on Maya. Cards reported the VRAM free 0.6 s after the stop; the 16 GiB check passed and Maya loaded for about 145 s. The load then ended on the unchanged whole-card startup headroom check (below 1 GiB) because a game on the display card held about 850 MiB more VRAM than during the earlier successful load. Not retested to a finished answer.
